title: Organisation
description: A type foundry, font publisher, press or institution linked to typefaces or people in the registry.

id.description: Permanent opaque identifier. Never reused, never changed once assigned.

slug.description: URL/filename-friendly slug. May change if a record is renamed; id does not.

previous_slugs.description: Slugs this record used to have before being renamed. The build emits a redirect stub page at each old URL pointing at the current one, so old links keep working. Append the old slug here whenever you change `slug`, never remove an entry once added.

native.description: The name written in its own script(s), as found in a source.

kind.description: foundry: makes and sells type. publisher: issues fonts as part of a wider business. press: a printing press that cut or cast its own type. institution: a university, research body or non-profit.

location.description: City or place, as stated in a source.

lc_naf.description: Library of Congress/NACO Authority File id, e.g. 'n79021164'.

worldcat_entity.description: OCLC WorldCat Entity id, the string after id.oclc.org/worldcat/entity/. Note: the WorldCat.org detail page for an entity currently prompts for a library-affiliated login to view, unlike the other authority files here, still worth recording as a cross-reference even though the page itself isn't always freely browsable.

ulan.description: Getty Union List of Artist Names (ULAN) numeric id, e.g. '500104874'. A cross-reference only. A ULAN record page may also be cited in sources[].

external_ids.description: Informational cross-references only, one per authority file. Never usable as a sources entry.

type.description: What kind of document this is. Descriptive only.

language.description: Language of the source, as a BCP 47 tag (e.g. en, or, sat, hi, ar).

date.description: Publication date as given by the source (YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD).

archive_url.description: An archived copy of url, e.g. on web.archive.org.

sources.description: Independent, verifiable sources. Must never be Wikidata, Wikipedia, or any Wikimedia project, enforced by scripts/validate.js.

username.description: Account name, such as a GitHub login. Kept in the data; the site credits name.

contributed_by.description: Who submitted or substantially contributed this record's entry - distinct from the record's own subject. The first entry is treated as the record's citation author (see site-templates/shared.js buildCitations). Auto-filled for issue-form submissions with the submitter's public GitHub name, or their login if no name is public, plus their login as username; add by hand when opening a PR directly, see CONTRIBUTING.md. Also powers the /contributors/ page. Omit entirely for records researched and entered by the registry's own maintainers - the citation falls back to the default maintainer credit in that case.
